physics: Actual beta/physics.js, dt 1/180 s, open goals, rounded corners, real skill hooks; no opening-shot score veto or goal-mouth closure.
scope: Every ordered pairing of the three retained presets, both attacking sides and every eligible firing slot. Goal-target and one-side-wall-bank aim lines supplement each direct-angle grid. Skill procs are forced in the named branches. Each simulation ends only at a goal or zero remaining motion.
limitations: Finite deterministic samples are regression evidence, not a mathematical impossibility proof over continuous angles, powers or all ordered roster assignments.
The enlarged sweep covers every ordered opponent Haaland/Fandui slot placement; it is not exhaustive over all simultaneous own-side non-shooter size permutations.
Passive Suya checks place one non-shooting friendly or enemy Suya in each slot and force both red-card outcomes, separately from the size-layout sweep.
Extra Messi actions are subsequent actions, not part of the initial shot. Post-goal setups with persistent removals are not claimed to retain full-squad opening coverage.

runs.name: main
runs.note: Only retained final-three preset matchups are counted; trials involving the discarded fourth preset are excluded.
